import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path

base = Path('products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad')
source = base / 'decision-table-rehearsal.json'
raw = source.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == 'c693ebb227fd49d6d60ccf2a49a213a4bcdb6a0f148007481f0c6afffd1626a5'
data = json.loads(raw)
assert len(data['checks']) == 5 and all(row['passed'] is True and row['actual'] == row['expected'] for row in data['checks'])

def strings(node):
    if isinstance(node, str):
        yield node.strip()
    elif isinstance(node, dict):
        for value in node.values():
            yield from strings(value)

starts = {
    'diagnostic': ('Thanks for asking about catalogue QA.', 'Merci pour votre demande de contrôle de catalogue.'),
    'commission': ('Thanks for asking about commissioned catalogue QA.', 'Merci'),
}
replies = {}
for branch, (en_start, fr_start) in starts.items():
    leaves = list(strings(data['operator_reply_drafts'][branch]))
    combined = [value for value in leaves if value.startswith('EN\n') and '\nFR\n' in value and en_start in value]
    if combined:
        assert len(combined) == 1, branch
        english, french = re.split(r'\n+FR\n', combined[0][3:], maxsplit=1)
    else:
        english, = [value for value in leaves if value.removeprefix('EN\n').startswith(en_start)]
        french, = [value for value in leaves if value.removeprefix('FR\n').startswith(fr_start)]
        english = english.removeprefix('EN\n')
        french = french.removeprefix('FR\n')
    assert 'autonomous ai' in english.lower() and 'autonomes' in french.lower(), branch
    replies[branch] = f'EN\n{english.strip()}\n\nFR\n{french.strip()}\n'
assert 'up to 20' in replies['diagnostic'] and 'manual' in replies['diagnostic']
assert 'authorized operator' in replies['commission'].lower() and 'confirmation' in replies['commission'].lower()
for branch, reply in replies.items():
    output = base / f'{branch}-reply-en-fr.txt'
    output.write_text(reply, encoding='utf-8')
    assert output.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == reply
    print(json.dumps({'branch': branch, 'path': str(output), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(output.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'observed_draft_keys': list(data['operator_reply_drafts'][branch])}, ensure_ascii=False))

description: Five fictional catalogue intake checks passed. The reply readback failed because it expected strings and found nested objects. Extract and verify the existing bilingual replies so the authorized private cycle can use them for an eligible inquiry. A commission still requires operator-approved terms and buyer confirmation. Commercial feedback has no classified requests and five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury shows CAD 0 available and no verified revenue.
